name: OSINT Framework
description: The classic tree of free OSINT tools by category. This hub's catalog started from it.

name: IntelTechniques Tools
description: Michael Bazzell's custom search tools and workflows for people, usernames, domains, vehicles and more.

name: OSINT.link
description: A large categorised bookmark directory of OSINT sites and resources.

name: Awesome OSINT
description: The biggest curated GitHub list of OSINT tools, bookmarks, APIs and tutorials, sorted by category.

name: Bellingcat Online Investigations Toolkit
description: Bellingcat's own directory of tools for investigative journalism, geolocation and image or map analysis.

name: Start.me
description: Public dashboards where researchers share thousands of OSINT links. Search for OSINT boards.

name: SpiderFoot
description: Automated OSINT engine: give it an IP, domain or email and it queries 100+ sources and graphs the result. Self-hosted.

name: Recon-ng
description: Python web reconnaissance framework with modules and API keys, driven from the command line.

name: Maltego
description: Visual link analysis: pivot between entities and see the relationship graph. Free community edition with limits.

name: WhatsMyName
description: Username enumeration data and scripts across hundreds of sites. This hub's username scan uses its list.

name: Maigret
description: Builds a profile dossier from a username by checking thousands of sites. Self-hosted.

name: SecurityTrails
description: Historical DNS records and subdomain mapping. This hub can query its API when SECURITYTRAILS_API_KEY is set.
